statement_summary: Board designates the ISO in writing
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; High risks go to the board
Sanctions recorded; good-faith reporting protected
Vendor due diligence, contract terms, and annual SOC review with CUEC mapping
Annual independent testing engaged by the Supervisory Committee
Annual board report; quarterly status
Annual policy review; policies available to staff
Security records kept at least 5 years
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Unique accounts; shared mailboxes only by delegation
Least privilege with written approval; override profile limited
MFA everywhere including MSP-held and cloud console logins; IP allowlist where no MFA
Termination checklist completed by the last day, including shared passwords and wire tokens
Monthly account reconciliation; quarterly role check
10-minute device lock with no teller exemption
Member MFA at new devices and sensitive changes; member alerts; verified contact changes
Named MSP and vendor accounts with MFA; yearly technician list
Password length; change shared secrets when anyone leaves
Wire security procedure: callback to the number on file; no emailed instructions alone; approver checks the callback record
regulatory_driver: N52-R01 (748 App. A III.C.1.a); III.C.1.e); Fla. Stat. 670.202

statement_summary: Need-to-know look-ups only; no own or family accounts
No member information in personal accounts or public AI tools
Lock screens; never share passwords, MFA codes, or wire tokens
Training at hire and yearly with BEC and wire fraud content; phishing exercises
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
BEC and fraudulent wire runbook kept and printed
Report suspected fraudulent wires within 15 minutes and other incidents within 1 hour
Log every incident
Reportable cyber incident decision recorded; NCUA notice within 72 hours
NCUA Regional Director notice and investigation for sensitive member information
Member notice with Appendix B content; state notices per P08
regulatory_driver: N52-R01 (748 App. B II.A.1.e; III); Fla. Stat. 501.171

statement_summary: SAR within 30 days; immediate telephone notice for ongoing violations; confidentiality
Cyber insurer and bond carrier notified before outside firms
Ransom or extortion payment only with board approval and an OFAC check
Vendor incident reports logged; credit union still sends notices
Annual tabletop exercise with the MSP
Lessons learned within 30 days; summary in the board report
Three classification levels; SAR information limited
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit; secure upload for members
Restricted data only in approved systems; mailbox documents moved within 30 days
Inventory of devices, vendor services, and member information locations
ISO approves new vendors, features, and security-relevant changes
Approved AI tools only
Imaging backup copy in a separate account; quarterly restore test; vital records log
Wipe or certified destruction with records
Retention of member, SAR, and security records
